caption: The drawing features two renderings of a cape, both depicted on a beige background. The primary rendering, located on the left, is a detailed, colored drawing of a cape in shades of black and grey. The cape has three distinct horizontal tiers, each edged with intricate lace patterns. The top tier is fastened around the neckline with a visible ribbon or bow. The lace edges are prominent along each tier, adding texture and decoration to the garment. The cape is displayed as if draped over invisible shoulders, with faint, unfinished lines suggesting the rest of the figure below the garment. To the right of the main illustration, there is a second, smaller outline drawing of the same cape, showing the back view. This outline is done in simple black lines, lacking color and detail, but it also includes the scalloped lace edges and the structure of the three tiers, as well as the ribbon or bow detail at the neckline. The overall composition centers the colored garment, while the outline provides additional perspective on its construction.
title: Cape
